They will discuss with you your ideas and retail proposition and any property works that might be required.</span></p>

Add statement that recommended but not compulsory</span></p>

    <details role="group">
        <summary role="button" class="c-accordion u-bg-aqua">
            <img class="c-accordion__icon" src="/img/icon-business-plan.png" alt="">

        </summary>

        <div class="o-wrapper u-pb4">
            <p>You've visited the competitor pubs and have instructed a qualified accountant to work with you on completing your business plan. It's important that both you, and any other named persons on the agreement, complete a profile in addition to
                confirming your chosen legal business structure.</p>

            <table class="table-timeline u-mb2">
                <thead>
                    <tr>

            <p><strong>Your actions to do</strong></p>

            <div class="flex u-mb3">
                <div data-component="todo-summary" class="w-50 u-ph1">
                    <p class="u-mb0">Instruct a qualified accountant <span data-toggletip class="dib w-33 u-mb0">Choose and instruct a qualified Accountant to work with you on your business plan. A list of BII qualified Accountants can be found <strong>here</strong>.</span></p>
                </div>

                <div data-component="todo-action" class="w-40 u-ph1">
                    <div class="u-mb0"></div>

                </div>

                <div data-component="todo-action" class="w-40 u-ph1">

            <div class="flex u-mb3">

                    <p class="u-mb0">Consider company set up <span data-toggletip class="dib w-33 u-mb0">Before you produce your business plan, please consider how the business will be set up, i.e. Sole Trader or a Limited Company. The business plan must be submitted in this / these name(s).</span></p>
                </div>

                <div data-component="todo-action" class="w-40 u-ph1">
                    <div class="u-mb0"></div>
                </div>

                <div data-component="todo-status" class="w-10 u-ph1">
                    <img src="/img/tick-green.png" />
                </div>

            </div>
            <div class="flex u-mb3">

                </div>

                <div data-component="todo-action" class="w-40 u-ph1">
                    <div class="u-mb0"></div>

            <div class="flex u-mb3">

            <div class="flex u-mb3">
                <div data-component="todo-summary" class="w-50 u-ph1">
                    <p class="u-mb0">Read through our property service packs and repair obligations <span data-toggletip class="dib w-33 u-mb0">We recommend to read further information on our <strong>property service packs and repairing obligations</strong>.</span></p>

            <div class="flex u-mb3">
                <div data-component="todo-summary" class="w-50 u-ph1">
                    <p class="u-mb0">Complete profile <span data-toggletip class="dib w-33 u-mb0">Please ensure your completed profile is submitted including uploading your Personal Licence, proof of funding, Right to Work and training certificates – please ensure everyone that is going to be named on your agreement has submitted their individual Profiles.</span></p>

                    <div class="u-mb0"></div>
                </div>

                <div data-component="todo-status" class="w-10 u-ph1">

            </div>
            <div class="flex u-mb3">
                <div data-component="todo-summary" class="w-50 u-ph1">
                    <p class="u-mb0">Accountant to upload final business plan <span data-toggletip class="dib w-33 u-mb0">Please provide your Accountant with your business plan upload code, this will allow them to upload your final business plan.</span></p>
                </div>

                    <div class="u-mb0"></div>

                <div data-component="todo-status" class="w-10 u-ph1">

            </div>
            <div class="flex u-mb3">
                <div data-component="todo-summary" class="w-50 u-ph1">
                    <p class="u-mb0">Confirm if independent advice taken <span data-toggletip class="dib w-33 u-mb0">Please inform our DLM/RM if you have taken independent legal/rental/property advice. If so, please confirm who from.</span></p>

            </div>
            <div class="flex u-mb3">
                <div data-component="todo-summary" class="w-50 u-ph1">
                    <p class="u-mb0">Read Landlord & Tenant Act 1954 and declaration <span data-toggletip class="dib w-33 u-mb0">The agreement you are agreeing to is contracted out of the Landlord & Tenant Act 1954. We will issue you with a simple declaration which details your rights. We strongly recommend that you take independent legal advice. Please note that all parties need to sign this declaration 14 days before completion.</span></p>

    <details role="group">
        <summary role="button" class="c-accordion u-bg-pear">

        <div class="o-wrapper u-pb4">
            <p>It's almost time for you to start your exciting career as a publican. We'll agree a handover day with you; this is when you will sign your agreement. We will do all we can to help you prepare for day one in your pub and ensure that everything
                is set up for your opening night.</p>

            <table class="table-timeline u-mb2">
                <thead>
                    <tr>

                <div data-component="todo-summary" class="w-50 u-ph1">
                    <p class="u-mb0">Read through your Pre Contract form <span data-toggletip class="dib w-33 u-mb0">Your agreement and associated documents will be issued via email for you to review. It will detail all of your agreed terms and must be signed by all named parties.</span></p>

            <div class="flex u-mb3">
                <div data-component="todo-summary" class="w-50 u-ph1">
                    <p class="u-mb0">Make Pre-Completion Statement funds payment <span data-toggletip class="dib w-33 u-mb0">Your Pre-Completion Statement (PCS) will detail the funds required. One of the team will call you to take payment before your completion day.</span></p>

    <details role="group">
        <summary role="button" class="c-accordion u-bg-purple">

        </div>
    </details>

<script>
    var app = new Vue({

<script>
    (function() {
        // Get all the toggletip buttons
        var toggletipTexts = document.querySelectorAll('[data-toggletip]');
        // Iterate over them
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(toggletipTexts, function(toggletipText) {
            // Create the container element
            var container = document.createElement('span');
            container.setAttribute('class', 'toggletip');
            // Put it before the original element in the DOM
            toggletipText.parentNode.insertBefore(container, toggletipText);
            // Create the button element
            var toggletip = document.createElement('button');
            toggletip.setAttribute('type', 'button');
            toggletip.setAttribute('aria-label', 'more info');
            toggletip.setAttribute('data-toggletip-content', toggletipText.textContent);
            toggletip.textContent = '?';
            // Place the button element in the container
            container.appendChild(toggletip);
            // Create the live region
            var liveRegion = document.createElement('span');
            liveRegion.setAttribute('role', 'status');
            // Place the live region in the container
            container.appendChild(liveRegion);
            // Remove the original element
            toggletipText.parentNode.removeChild(toggletipText);
            // Build `data-tooltip-content` 
            var message = toggletip.getAttribute('data-toggletip-content');
            toggletip.setAttribute('data-toggletip-content', message);
            toggletip.removeAttribute('title');
            // Get the message from the data-content element
            var message = toggletip.getAttribute('data-toggletip-content');
            // Get the live region element
            var liveRegion = toggletip.nextElementSibling;
            // Toggle the message
            toggletip.addEventListener('click', function() {
                liveRegion.innerHTML = '';
                window.setTimeout(function() {
                    liveRegion.innerHTML = '<div class="toggletip__bubble">' + message + '</div>';
                }, 100);
            });
            // Close on outside click
            document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (toggletip !== e.target) {
                    liveRegion.innerHTML = '';
                }
            });
            // Remove toggletip on ESC
            toggletip.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                if ((e.keyCode || e.which) === 27)
                    liveRegion.innerHTML = '';
            });
            // Remove on blur
            toggletip.addEventListener('blur', function(e) {
                liveRegion.innerHTML = '';
            });
        });
    }());
</script>
 
{{> @header }}

<div class="o-wrapper u-pb4">
  <div id="app">
    {{ message }}
  </div>


  <h1>Timeline</h1>

  <div id="app">
    <p> My name is {{ message }}</p>
  </div>

  <p>Applying for: {{ pubShortAddress }}</p>
  <p>Applying with: {{ applicantName }}</p>

  <h2 class="f3">Actions Overview</h2> 

  <details role="group" open>
    <summary role="button" class="c-accordion u-bg-gold">
      <img class="c-accordion__icon" src="/img/icon-meet.png" alt="">
      <h3 class="c-accordion__title  u-white">Let's meet and talk</h3>
    </summary>
    
    <div class="o-wrapper u-pb4">
      {{!-- Section summary --}}
      <p>So you've found the right pub for you! It's now time to start completing your profile and for you to meet our team to discuss your future pub business. You should have received some information from our recruitment team telling you more about your chosen pub.</p>

      {{{ actionsHeader }}}

      {{# step1actions }}
      <div class="u-flex u-mb3">
        <div data-component="todo-summary" class="w-50 u-ph1">
          <p class="u-mb0">{{{ toDoSummary }}} <span data-toggletip class="dib w-33 u-mb0">{{{ toDoLongDesc }}}</span></p>
        </div>

        <div data-component="todo-action" class="w-40 u-ph1">
          <div class="u-mb0">{{{ toDoActions }}}</div>
        </div>

        <div data-component="todo-status" class="w-10 u-ph1">
          {{{toDoStatus }}}
        </div>

      </div> 
      {{/ step1actions }}
      <hr />
      
      <p class="u-mt2 u-mb0"><strong>Milestones</strong></p>
      <ul>
        {{# step1milestones }}
        <li class="u-pv1">{{{ milestoneSummary }}}</li>
        {{/ step1milestones }}
      </ul>
    </div>
  </details>

  <details role="group">
    <summary role="button" class="c-accordion u-bg-aqua">
      <img class="c-accordion__icon" src="/img/icon-business-plan.png" alt="">
      <p class="c-accordion__title  u-white">Planning your business</p>
    </summary>
    
    <div class="o-wrapper u-pb4">
      {{!-- Section summary --}}
      <p>You've visited the competitor pubs and have instructed a qualified accountant to work with you on completing your business plan. It's important that both you, and any other named persons on the agreement, complete a profile in addition to confirming your chosen legal business structure.</p>

      {{{ actionsHeader }}}

      {{# step2actions }}
      <div class="flex u-mb3">
        <div data-component="todo-summary" class="w-50 u-ph1">
          <p class="u-mb0">{{{ toDoSummary }}} <span data-toggletip class="dib w-33 u-mb0">{{{ toDoLongDesc }}}</span></p>
        </div>

        <div data-component="todo-action" class="w-40 u-ph1">
          <div class="u-mb0">{{{ toDoActions }}}</div>
        </div>

        <div data-component="todo-status" class="w-10 u-ph1">
          {{{toDoStatus }}}
        </div>

      </div> 
      {{/ step2actions }}
      <hr />
      
      <p class="u-mt2 u-mb0"><strong>Milestones</strong></p>
      <ul>
        {{# step2milestones }}
        <li class="u-pv1">{{{ milestoneSummary }}}</li>
        {{/ step2milestones }}
      </ul>
    </div>
  </details>

  <details role="group">
    <summary role="button" class="c-accordion u-bg-pear">
      <img class="c-accordion__icon" src="/img/icon-agree.png" alt="">
      <p class="c-accordion__title  u-white">Agreeing terms and advice</p>
    </summary>
    
    <div class="o-wrapper u-pb4">
      {{!-- Section summary --}}
      <p>It's almost time for you to start your exciting career as a publican. We'll agree a handover day with you; this is when you will sign your agreement. We will do all we can to help you prepare for day one in your pub and ensure that everything is set up for your opening night.</p>

      {{{ actionsHeader }}}
      {{# step3actions }}
      <div class="flex u-mb3">
        <div data-component="todo-summary" class="w-50 u-ph1">
          <p class="u-mb0">{{{ toDoSummary }}} <span data-toggletip class="dib w-33 u-mb0">{{{ toDoLongDesc }}}</span></p>
        </div>

        <div data-component="todo-action" class="w-40 u-ph1">
          <div class="u-mb0">{{{ toDoActions }}}</div>
        </div>

        <div data-component="todo-status" class="w-10 u-ph1">
        {{{toDoStatus }}}
        </div>
      </div> 
      {{/ step3actions }}
      <hr />
      
      <p class="u-mt2 u-mb0"><strong>Milestones</strong></p>
      <ul>
        {{# step3milestones }}
        <li class="u-pv1">{{{ milestoneSummary }}}</li>
        {{/ step3milestones }}
      </ul>
    </div>
  </details>

  <details role="group">
    <summary role="button" class="c-accordion u-bg-purple">
      <img class="c-accordion__icon" src="/img/icon-signing.png" alt="">
      <p class="c-accordion__title  u-white">Signing your agreement</p>
    </summary>
    
    <div class="o-wrapper u-pb4">
      {{!-- Section summary --}}
      <p>It's time to sign your agreement! We look forward to giving you all the support you need to grow and develop your business. Your Regional Manager will be with you every step of the way and will visit you regularly, especially during your first months to make sure you are set up for long-term success.</p>

      {{{ actionsHeader }}}

      {{# step4actions }}
      <div class="flex u-mb3">
        <div data-component="todo-summary" class="w-50 u-ph1">
          <p class="u-mb0">{{{ toDoSummary }}} <span data-toggletip class="dib w-33 u-mb0">{{{ toDoLongDesc }}}</span></p>
        </div>

        <div data-component="todo-action" class="w-40 u-ph1">
          <div class="u-mb0">{{{ toDoActions }}}</div>
        </div>

        <div data-component="todo-status" class="w-10 u-ph1">
          {{{toDoStatus }}}
        </div>

      </div> 
      {{/ step4actions }}
      <hr />
      <p class="u-mt2 u-mb0"><strong>Milestones</strong></p>
      <ul>
        {{# step4milestones }}
        <li class="u-pv1">{{{ milestoneSummary }}}</li>
        {{/ step4milestones }}
      </ul>
    </div>
  </details>
</div>

<script>
  (function() {

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(toggletipTexts, function(toggletipText) {
      
      // Create the container element
      var container = document.createElement('span');
      container.setAttribute('class', 'toggletip');
      
      // Put it before the original element in the DOM
      toggletipText.parentNode.insertBefore(container, toggletipText);
      
      // Create the button element
      var toggletip = document.createElement('button');
      toggletip.setAttribute('type', 'button');
      toggletip.setAttribute('aria-label', 'more info');
      toggletip.setAttribute('data-toggletip-content', toggletipText.textContent);
      toggletip.textContent = '?';
      
      // Place the button element in the container
      container.appendChild(toggletip);
      
      // Create the live region
      var liveRegion = document.createElement('span');
      liveRegion.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      
      // Place the live region in the container
      container.appendChild(liveRegion);
      
      // Remove the original element
      toggletipText.parentNode.removeChild(toggletipText);
      
      // Build `data-tooltip-content` 
      var message = toggletip.getAttribute('data-toggletip-content');
      toggletip.setAttribute('data-toggletip-content', message);
      toggletip.removeAttribute('title');
      
      // Get the message from the data-content element
      var message = toggletip.getAttribute('data-toggletip-content');

      // Get the live region element
      var liveRegion = toggletip.nextElementSibling;

      // Toggle the message
      toggletip.addEventListener('click', function() {
          liveRegion.innerHTML = '';
          window.setTimeout(function() {
            liveRegion.innerHTML = '<div class="toggletip__bubble">'+ message +'</div>';
          }, 100);
      });

      // Close on outside click
      document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        if (toggletip !== e.target) {
          liveRegion.innerHTML = '';
        }                        
      });

      // Remove toggletip on ESC
      toggletip.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if ((e.keyCode || e.which) === 27)
        liveRegion.innerHTML = '';
      });
      
      // Remove on blur
      toggletip.addEventListener('blur', function (e) {
        liveRegion.innerHTML = '';
      });
    });

  }());
</script>
